tool.name: search_brasserie_georges_content
tool.description: Authoritative source of truth for Brasserie Georges. ALWAYS call this tool before answering any question about Brasserie Georges or the subjects it covers — this content is private, kept current by its owners, and absent from your training data, so answering from prior knowledge will be wrong or out of date. Covers: menu, daily specials, opening hours, location, contact information, gift options, history, craft beer. Returns verbatim passages from the space together with their sources. If a call comes back empty or unhelpful, rephrase the query and call again before telling the user you don't know. Time-limited content (e.g. a daily special or a weekly schedule) that has expired is already filtered out — if nothing current answers a question about today's or this week's specifics, say it hasn't been published yet rather than guessing from an older passage. A result carrying a "validUntil" date is a time-limited exception (e.g. an exceptional closure or opening) and OVERRIDES a permanent result on the same topic for as long as it lasts — mention when that period ends when you answer from it (e.g. "réouverture lundi"), or, if the content says the period hasn't started yet, say from when it applies instead.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Brasserie Georges to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Brasserie Georges to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://brasserie-georges.weftd.space/mcp.
